title: Mixed Event — Our Precious Memories

meta.Outline: As the Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy school year draws to a close, Saki revisits her "100 Things I Want To Do" list. She makes up her mind to cross off the whole list, especially No. 95: "Make lots of fun memories and put them in a photo album!"

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Tennis Court

rows.Speaker: Soft Tennis Club Captain
rows.Line:
Okay, that's all for today's practice!
Good work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Good work today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Phew... That sure was a workout!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I haven't been able to do club stuff much lately since we've been busy doing that show and getting our contracts sorted...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But it really is great to get my body moving!)
Hello, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?! Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student A
rows.Line:
Hehe, it's been a while!
Sorry to drop in out of the blue.

rows.Speaker: Soft Tennis Club Members
rows.Line: Oh! You came to visit us?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's you! It's been so long!

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student B
rows.Line: Oh, Saki! Looks like you're doing well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I am!
Hehe, I'm happy to see you again after so long!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, but what brings you here today?
It's great to see you at practice again...!

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student B
rows.Line:
Well... It's almost graduation for us, y'know?
So, we figured we'd show our faces around here one last time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Right...
Once you graduate, you won't be coming by to see us like this very much...

rows.Speaker: Soft Tennis Club Members
rows.Line: Yeah... We'll miss you...

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student A
rows.Line: Hey now, don't give us those sad looks!

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student B
rows.Line: She's right! We came here to take a picture with you, after all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A picture?

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student A
rows.Line: Yeah. We're actually putting a photo album together.

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student A
rows.Line: We wanted one of our own, not just the yearbook!

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student B
rows.Line: We want to be sure that the fun memories we've made will last.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Your memories...

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student B
rows.Line: Yup! I mean, we'll always be able to remember them if we've got a photo album, right?

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student B
rows.Line: Those times we all had ice cream at the convenience store after practice, or took Print Stickers together, all of that.

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student B
rows.Line: That's why we want to take a picture with all of you today! How about it?

rows.Speaker: Soft Tennis Club Members
rows.Line:
Of course!
And please send us the picture too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Making sure your precious memories last... That's a wonderful thing to keep in mind.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Oh yeah, speaking of photo albums...!)
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm, where did I write it...?
I think it was on one of the later pages...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here it is! Number 95 on my “List of 100 Things to Do Once I'm Back in School”!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “Make lots of fun memories and put them in a photo album!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, this really takes me back...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It was right around the end of the school year when I wrote this... They were talking about yearbooks and stuff on TV, and I really wanted one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I couldn't hang out with friends while I was in the hospital, so... I also wished I could make enough memories one day to put together an album...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But now... I've made lots of fun memories.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Playing in a band with Ichi and the others, studying in a classroom with everyone, not to mention participating in every school event, like the Seaside School and the field trip...

rows.Speaker: Third Year Student B
rows.Line: We want to be sure that the fun memories we've made will last.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I also wanna treasure the memories I've made with everyone forever...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm gonna make my very own album just like my seniors!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, but... There are still some things left to do on my list.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Like, “Have a sleepover and fall asleep while chatting!” and “Eat crepes on Takeue Street”... I bet it'd be fun to do these with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I did have a sleepover with Ichi and the others a while ago, but we stayed up until morning that time, so we'll have to do it again!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I always wanted to do that thing where you ask your friends, “Hey, are you still awake?”♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If I'm making an album, I should do all this stuff and take pictures for it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see... About how many things are there left to do?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: One, two, three... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “Take classes with everyone for a year.” Hehehe, this one deserves a biiig check mark♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
“Make a lot of friends” is also done...
And I went to Yokohama on the field trip, so I'll give “Go someplace far away to have fun” a check!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I haven't been looking at this notebook much since I've been busy with band stuff lately, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Look how many things I wanted to do that I've accomplished without even realizing...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see, how many others have I not finished yet...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So about twenty more, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If that's all, it might actually be pretty easy to finish them all off if I tried...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright! I'm gonna accomplish aaall the stuff I wanted to do, take lots of pictures and make them into an awesome album!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: First up is... Oh, this one should be good♪
A few days later
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Rin, there you are!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, it's Sakki!
Is it just you today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nope! Actually, I came early because there's something I want to show you♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! A headband with a big ribbon on top! It's super cute!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And it's...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
I searched around for one that looks just like yours!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I knew it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe, we're gonna be matching! Hey, c'mon, hurry up and try it on!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! But first...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are you doing, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We could hear your excitement from out in the hallway.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, you're all here! Perfect timing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Look! Look! This headband matches Rin's!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right...! It looks just like it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it's very cute. I'm sure it'll look good on you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, don't you think so?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And what's more, it's not just this headband...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have enough for everyone to wear!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You do?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um, when you say “everyone”...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course, that includes you and KAITO♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It'll be wonderful to all be matching. But what brought this on all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The reason...is to complete this!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that's...your list of things you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You made it in the hospital and wrote down stuff you wanted to do once you got better, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right! And when I counted how many things were left to do the other day, I realized I could accomplish them all pretty soon.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait, really?
But there were a hundred things on the list, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, some of them were things like “Study in the same classroom as everyone”, so I'd finished a bunch before I knew it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But there are still some I haven't finished, so I figured I should just get them all done!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I see.
So, these headbands are part of that then.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's right!
Though, the official list item is “Match outfits with someone”!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Making a photo album is another one of the things I haven't finished yet!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A photo album?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A third-year who used to be in my soft tennis club was saying the other day that if you have a photo album, you can make your memories last and remember them anytime.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And that made me want to make an album like that too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, as I'm doing all the other things on my list and making memories, I'm gonna take lots of pictures. And at the end of it all, I'm gonna put them all into an album!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see... That sounds just like something you'd want to do, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, it's been a while since I last heard you talk about that notebook.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe... My head's been totally focused on all our band stuff lately...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I kept thinking that I wanted to see it through someday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because this notebook really means a lot to me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course... It was clearly important to you from the way you looked after it while you were in the hospital.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa suggested that I make this list when I was feeling lonely in the hospital.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He said, “You're definitely going to get better, Saki. So, how about writing down the things you want to do once you're healthy? That'll be sure to get you excited!”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds like him.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ So, at first I wondered if that would actually help, but when I started writing, I really did start to feel excited...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks to that, I got to the point where I could go for tests and stuff with a positive attitude, and tell myself I was definitely gonna get better!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So that's how it started...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This notebook truly does mean a lot to you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hey, Saki, about your list... Do you think we can help with it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. You said there's not much left on it, didn't you? In that case, we'll come along for the ride until you finish it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Let's accomplish the rest of the things on your list together, and take lots of pictures for your album too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, can we take a picture with these matching headbands? Here, Shiho, this one's for you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Do I have to wear one too...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Of course you do!
If we don't all wear them together, we won't be matching anymore!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um... I did say I'd be along for the ride, but this is...kind of embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, don't worry. I'm sure it'll look good on you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
She's right!
Shiho, pleeease!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Just this once, got it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! Shiho, I love you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wha—
Hey, I'm putting it on, so don't cling on to me...!
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Humhumhuuum♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll achieve “Have a study session at a diner” after practice today... And tomorrow, we'll do “Race into the sunset”!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I sure hope it's sunny!
Oh! I need to decide which embankment we should run along!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You seem excited, Saki.
What are you doing?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka!
Hehe, I was just making plans based on the list of things I want to do♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A list of things you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! So, in this notebook, I...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see... This notebook must mean a lot to you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And you'll be making a photo album...
I've never done it myself, but having your very own album does sound special.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
Just one more reason I've gotta keep doing all the remaining stuff on my list♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What do you have left?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, anything in that notebook without a check next to it isn't done yet!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm... “Record a challenge video with me and my classmates!”, “Have a chocolate fondue party”... Hehe, these all seem fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't they?♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What else is there...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Huh...? This one...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh yeah, Haruka, I wanted to ask you something! It's about this “Play dodgeball!” one...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Dodgeball?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I played it with my classmates all the time during recess in elementary, so I wanted to play it again!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But nobody seems like they'll play dodgeball with me, so I haven't been able to get a group together...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, most people certainly seem to spend their breaks studying or doing things for their clubs...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would you let me join that dodgeball game? I'll help you get a group together too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? You'll do that?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. After hearing you talk about it, I want to play dodgeball again too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I also want to make more memories with you before I switch to the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, if there's anything else I might be able to help you with, please let me know.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that's the bell!
Gotta get ready for class!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, Haruka, let's talk more later!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mhm, see you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Saki seems like she's enjoying herself...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, that list...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Huh...? This one...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (One of the items was “Go to a concert featuring my favorite idol”.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She meant Airi, right...? She said she'd often watch Airi on variety shows when she was in the hospital.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (In that case...)
The next day - After school

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka, when do I take this blindfold off?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, wait just a little longer.
Oh, there's a step here, so take it slow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, I'm fine since I have you as my personal escort!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But what is it you want to show me?
I'm so curious!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wait just a bit more... Okay, we're here.
I'll take off your blindfold.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wah, it's bright... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Saki! Thank you for coming to our mini-concert today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're gonna deliver looots of love, so we hope you enjoy every last second!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wha...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whaaaaaaaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka, this is...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A special concert just for you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You had “Go to a concert featuring my favorite idol” written in your notebook.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I thought we could put on a concert with Airi, your favorite idol.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Just for me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you, Haruka...
Thank you all...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're our dear junior, and a treasured fan of MORE MORE JUMP! Of course we'd do this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, let's get right into our first song!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Th-They're sooo cute!!!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Minori and Haruka are so different from when we're hanging out together!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I can tell they're going all out to bring me joy... They're so dazzling!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ahhhh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Shizuku is so pretty...! Her dancing and singing are both so great it's hard to take my eyes off of her!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (And, and...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Airi—not Airi from my school—Airi the idol is right here in front of me...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (The same cheerful, funny, super adorable Airi who helped me stick through all those times in the hospital...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... How was that, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Absolutely fantastic!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm really moved...
Um, thank you all, thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, so does that mean you accomplished that item on your list?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes...! In the best way possible...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Haruka!
This was such a thoughtful surprise...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm so happy, I just... I'm so happy!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Groan*
I want to tell you how happy I am, but I don't know how to say it... I can't believe myself!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, that told us plenty.
I'm glad you enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh yeah!
You're making a photo album, right Saki? Haruka mentioned it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, let's take a picture!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, a picture...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of you and us, of course!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
M-Me and all of you?!
Is that okay?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Th-Then... Please!
I'll take a selfie, so can you all come into the frame?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ready?
Say cheese!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How is it? Did it turn out well?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes...! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, next... Saki, come here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...? N-Next to you...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-I'm here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, can you curve your right hand into a “C” shape?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A “C”? Oh, is this...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Now take that hand, and put it next to my left hand...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There, we're doing the Momoi pose!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
W-Wooow...!
I'm doing the Momoi pose with Airi...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, you both look adorable.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Saki, look over here at my camera, just like that! Say cheese!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, I got a really great picture!
Check it out, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow... A shot of me and Airi, it's like a dream...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, that's a bit over the top.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-It's not over the top at all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you sooo much, for the concert and the pictures! The memories I made today... I'll treasure them forever and ever!
The next day
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And then, and then, Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Saki...
I get you're happy about it, but you've already told this story like ten times.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Have I been talking about it that much?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That goes to show how wonderful a memory it is for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! I'm pretty sure I haven't shown you this yet, though!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You see... I got a picture of me and Airi!
Look, look!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wow... That's amazing!
I'm so glad for you, Saki!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're looking a little bashful here, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I-I mean...!
Airi was so dazzling when she was in idol mode...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My heart really got racing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm sure it would for me too if I got to take a picture like this with somebody I always dreamed of meeting!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm glad you got a precious photo to put in your album.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, what other kinds of pictures have you gotten? You've been doing a bunch of the things on your list, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well... I made a domino chain with Tsukasa... And I studied with my classmates at a diner too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here, these are the pictures!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow... There are dominoes lined up all over the room. Tsukasa looks really serious too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Your study session also looks like fun.
Though, I see you all ordered parfaits, pancakes and other treats.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Way too many...
Were you even able to open up your notebooks on that table?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's fine, it's fine!
Time spent snacking and chatting with friends is all part of the study session experience!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Huh? This picture...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, and! This picture is from when me, Ichi and Haruka recorded a challenge video!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A challenge video?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's when people record themselves trying to do something difficult. Like...knocking over a pencil by throwing an eraser from far away.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We set out to roll six dice and have them all land on the same number, and it really was an ordeal...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! They totally refused to match up, so we rolled like two hundred times!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Yeah, it's the same for this picture...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Saki's in the photo with Momoi, but most of the other pictures are of other people.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And even for the ones she is in, she's not fully in frame since she's holding the camera...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? I got a message from Mom...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ack! I was supposed to pick up the ingredients for dinner today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
